commands.title: download-models
commands.description: Default pack only (Klein 4B + Wan 2.2 5B + LTX-2.5 + prompt-enhance GGUF). No --tier. --limit is bandwidth, not quality.

choices.label: auto (85% of speedtest when HTB works)

commands.title: download-image --tier
commands.description: Still UNET pack. fast is the lab default and also pulls TE + flux2-vae companions. Not a video quality ladder.

choices.label: fast — Klein 4B distilled FP8 + TE + VAE (default, in download-models)
base — Klein 4B base FP8 still UNET (optional)
all — fast + nvfp4 + base + zimage (Apache only)
9b — Klein 9B distilled FP8 + Qwen3-8B TE (FLUX Non-Commercial, not YouTube-ok)
small-vae — Apache FLUX.2 small decoder VAE
flux2-dev — FLUX.2 [dev] FP8 + Mistral TE (FLUX Non-Commercial, not YouTube-ok)

commands.title: download-wan --tier
commands.description: Different Wan graphs, not a quality ladder. all does not include vace or s2v. Unload LTX before Fun InP / VACE / S2V.

choices.label: 5b — Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B silent (~12 GB, in download-models)
a14b — Wan 2.2 I2V A14B FP8 (~20 GB, opt-in)
fun-inp — Fun InP A14B first-last-frame (~47 GB, floor 40)
vace — Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B join (~6 GB, not in all)
s2v — Wan 2.2 S2V-14B talking-head (~20 GB, not in all)
all — 5b + a14b + fun-inp (not vace, not s2v)

commands.title: download-ltx --tier
commands.description: LTX generation selector, not “better”. 2.5 is the lab default. balanced/quality are 2.3 aliases. all is 2.5+2.3+gemma (not iclora).

choices.label: 2.5 — distilled INT8-convrot AV (~30 GB, in download-models)
iclora — IC-LoRA Union Control (~1 GB, not in all)

commands.title: download-podcast --tier
commands.description: Opt-in audio packs. analog is Kokoro only. acestep shares the ~10 GB AIO with download-music --tier turbo. Missing pack is not a doctor failure.

choices.label: acestep — ACE-Step 1.5 turbo AIO (~10 GB, shared with music turbo)

commands.title: download-dub --tier
commands.description: Opt-in dub packs. asr is Silero VAD + faster-whisper. clone is Chatterbox Multilingual V3 (ve.pt + s3gen.pt + T3 V3 + conds.pt). With the stack up, pip-installs faster-whisper, setuptools<82 (PerTh / pkg_resources), then the Chatterbox V3 GitHub zip --no-deps --force-reinstall (does not pin torch; PyPI 0.1.7 has no t3_model=v3). Missing pack is not a doctor failure.

choices.label: clone — Chatterbox Multilingual V3 (MIT, PerTh on)

commands.title: download-music --tier
commands.description: Closest thing to a size ladder. turbo shares dest with download-podcast --tier acestep — do not pull the AIO twice. Occupancy: stop LTX/Wan/Klein first.

choices.label: turbo — ACE-Step 1.5 AIO (~10 GB, default rap/podcast beds)
xl — split XL files (larger; not the default)

commands.title: download-3d --tier
commands.description: Opt-in 3D. da3-large is refused. Unload LTX first. SuperSplat is a host viewer, not this downloader.

choices.label: trellis2 — Comfy-Org TRELLIS.2 INT8 + DINOv3 (~12 GB)
da3-base — Depth Anything 3 BASE Apache (~1 GB)

commands.title: download-longcat --tier
commands.description: Opt-in MIT LongCat. No NCCL in this sample stack.

commands.title: download-dreamx --tier
commands.description: Apache DreamX-Creator only. DreamX-World is refused.

choices.label: creator — DreamX-Creator 1.0 Apache (~8 GB selective, full repo ~54 GB)

commands.title: download-restore --tier
commands.description: Post-concat SeedVR2 restore pack. Not part of download-models.

commands.title: download-llm --tier
commands.description: Default enhance is the Qwen3-4B prompt-enhance GGUF (already in download-models). qwen36-35b-a3b is the opt-in ~23 GB occupancy llm-desk pack. describe is the opt-in Qwen2.5-VL caption GGUF. Missing 35B or describe is not a doctor failure.

choices.label: describe — Qwen2.5-VL-3B caption GGUF + mmproj (~4 GB)

commands.title: occupancy enter
commands.description: Park Comfy for blender-desk (POST /free) or llm-desk (35B sidecar), or enter a heavy family. Does not start Compose. NVENC stays XOR with compose-up. Graph occupancy label llm is not a CLI mode.

choices.label: klein — stop Blender and 35B sidecar, Queue stills
trellis — stop Blender and 35B sidecar, Queue TRELLIS.2
wan — stop Blender and 35B sidecar, Queue silent motion
ltx — stop Blender and 35B sidecar, Queue AV print
idle — stop Blender, 35B sidecar, and Compose

commands.title: research-mcp
commands.description: In-tree creative research MCP (chat, web_search, research, list_lab_apps). CPU GGUF. No execute_code. Does not refuse a GPU session.

commands.title: studio-mcp
commands.description: In-tree studio MCP (clone _lab graphs into live _user/; generate_app). CPU GGUF. No execute_code. Does not Queue.

commands.title: SSH port-forward
commands.description: Laptop tunnel to ComfyUI on the Spark. Then open http://127.0.0.1:${COMFY_PORT}.

commands.title: Open ComfyUI URL
commands.description: On-box / LAN URL. Use ssh-forward from a laptop instead.

commands.title: doctor
commands.description: Preflight. Missing weights are a warning, not a hard fail.

commands.title: start
commands.description: Type yes. Headroom preflight. Compose restart: no.

commands.title: stop
commands.description: Stop containers. Keeps models, outputs, and the comfy-state volume.

commands.title: reap-models --plan
commands.description: MODELS_DIR class plan only. Does not delete. cleanup does not delete weights.

commands.title: disk-wizard --plan
commands.description: Host-wide leftover survey. Read-only. Never docker system prune -a --volumes.

commands.title: help
commands.description: Print the manage.sh command list.

commands.title: setup
commands.description: .env, MODELS_DIR, COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR, optional Docker CE, hf CLI, then doctor.

flags.name: install-docker
flags.label: Install Docker CE + compose plugin when missing

commands.title: status
commands.description: Compose project status. Prints MODELS_DIR, COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR, port.

commands.title: restart
commands.description: stop then start. Full yes confirm and headroom again.

commands.title: logs
commands.description: Follow compose logs.

commands.title: download-limit
commands.description: Throttle Hugging Face pulls. wrap always clears on exit.

commands.title: clear-hf-locks
commands.description: Remove stale Hugging Face .lock files under MODELS_DIR.

commands.title: reset-hf-partials
commands.description: Delete *.incomplete under MODELS_DIR. Finished weights kept.

commands.title: print-shot
commands.description: Queue one compiled 90s shot into films/<slug>/shots/.

commands.title: film-resume
commands.description: Reprint failed 90s shots only. Skip ok 5.00s takes.

commands.title: film-export-otio
commands.description: Write films/<slug>/publish OTIO from the jobstore. Host-side.

commands.title: film-proxies
commands.description: NVENC proxies. Refuse if compose is up. Never rewrite masters.

commands.title: take-promote
commands.description: Copy a take into shots/NN.mp4 and mark the shot ok.

commands.title: promote-workflow
commands.description: Copy a live _user graph into workflows/_lab/<lane>/. Does not commit.

commands.title: album-render
commands.description: Queue one shipped album then zip. Compose must already be up.

commands.title: llm-sidecar
commands.description: Host llama-server for occupancy llm-desk (127.0.0.1:30000). Prefer occupancy enter llm-desk.

commands.title: blender-mcp
commands.description: In-tree typed Blender MCP. bpy tools need blender-desk. No execute_code.

commands.title: blender-llm
commands.description: Optional host Qwen3-4B CPU client for blender-mcp. Path D if llama.cpp missing.

commands.title: blender
commands.description: Host Blender sidecar. Workbench in blender-desk. Dies if Comfy is a heavy job.

commands.title: blender-install
commands.description: Host apt install of Ubuntu blender (universe). Never in the Dockerfile. Occupancy does not install Blender.

commands.title: export-guides
commands.description: Dump a 1280x704 (or 768x1280) / 120f clay+depth+canny pack. Dies if Comfy is heavy.

commands.title: blender-stills
commands.description: Dump a single-frame clay/depth/canny still. Dies if Comfy is heavy.

commands.title: house-views
commands.description: Dump 1024x1280 Instagram clay stills + GLB. Dies if Comfy is heavy.

commands.title: asset-ls
commands.description: Read-only Asset Bible catalog under COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR/assets.

commands.title: film-accept
commands.description: Fail-closed 90s gate: 5.00s, 1280x704, LTX audio.

commands.title: shot-sheet
commands.description: Write films/<slug>/shots.yaml with shot-card defaults.

commands.title: overlay-qc
commands.description: 50% clay/look overlay. Host ffmpeg; compose may stay up.

commands.title: film-animatic
commands.description: Cheap 90s animatic from clay.mp4 or stills. Host ffmpeg.

commands.title: stem-mix
commands.description: Picture-lock stems; duck -15 dB; YouTube loudnorm. Occupancy audio.

commands.title: audio-still-video
commands.description: Mux a still + audio master to YouTube MP4. Host ffmpeg; compose may stay up.

commands.title: spark-timing
commands.description: Kitchen wall-clock table. Do not record on pytorch-fallback.

commands.title: models-status
commands.description: Disk bible: keep-set + refuse list. Does not delete.

commands.title: cleanup
commands.description: Type DELETE. Removes ez-comfy-state only. Keeps MODELS_DIR and COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR.

commands.title: spark-farm status
commands.description: Probe independent Spark workers. Never starts compose remotely. No NCCL.
